description: Danish Whisper-large-v3 ASR (Edda v0.2 large) with optional lossless DFlash2 speculative decoding from the edda-v0.2-large-hurtig drafter.

request.name: language
request.description: Whisper language token for the decoder prompt; default da. The drafter was trained on Danish only.

request.name: speculative
request.description: Decode with the drafter when the checkpoint ships one. Output matches greedy decoding up to floating-point near-ties; default true.

request.name: draft_block
request.description: Speculative block size: the anchor token plus up to draft_block - 1 drafted tokens verified in one target pass; default 16, the drafter's trained block.

request.name: draft_selector
request.description: Pick drafted tokens with the DFlash2 candidate selector instead of per-slot argmax; default true.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum generated tokens per audio chunk, bounded by the 448-position decoder context; default 444.

request.name: audio_chunk_mode
request.description: auto splits audio longer than 30 seconds at silence boundaries; silence splits above the configured duration at silence boundaries; fixed splits at the configured duration; none disables splitting and accepts at most 30 seconds.

request.name: audio_chunk_duration_sec
request.description: Maximum chunk duration when splitting. In auto mode the 30-second trigger remains unchanged.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: Matmul weight storage override for Edda and the drafter; native preserves the supplied checkpoint types.

session.name: drafter
session.description: Load the speculative drafter when the checkpoint ships one; false saves its memory and decodes greedily.
